=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/ai_engine.sh: PR diff line ~309 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The single `||` chains both realpath calls, so a pool-directory resolution failure uses the `isolation_session_dir_unavailable` fallback label.
  WHY: The wrong fallback reason obscures diagnostics; the preflight already resolves `pool_dir` with `realpath -e` and fails closed, making this path unlikely in practice.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "restrict model reads to non-secret audit inputs" (from the linked issue recommendation: "supply model authentication through a host-side relay and restrict model reads to non-secret audit inputs")

  Evidence of absence: The read-profile container still mounts the full checkout read-only; README.md explicitly states "There is no per-file read allowlist yet." The specific pool-token exploit from the issue IS fixed (pool tokens are outside the container, Git config is masked, host relay holds the real credential). The broader "restrict model reads to non-secret audit inputs" clause is a documented, deferred limitation — not a newly introduced defect.
  SEVERITY: NIT

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:312 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `&& ... ||` clause chains two `realpath` calls together under a single fallback label, so a pool-directory resolution failure reports `isolation_session_dir_unavailable`.
  WHY: An operator may investigate the session directory instead of the pool directory; preflight already resolved `pool_real`, so the path is unlikely to fire in practice.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Keep pool tokens outside the model process's filesystem and user identity; supply model authentication through a host-side relay and restrict model reads to non-secret audit inputs." (issue #6236, Recommendation paragraph, third clause)
  Expected change site: scripts/ai_engine.sh in `_ai_engine_claude_run_isolated`, the `mounts=(--mount "type=bind,src=${workdir},dst=${workdir},readonly")` and the loop that mounts each `AI_ENGINE_ISOLATION_PATHS` entry, plus any per-role read inventory that would scope these mounts to non-secret audit inputs.
  Evidence of absence: The PR mounts the full checkout read-only and every configured extra read path inside the `--network none` container; the new last-run overlap guard at scripts/ai_engine.sh:312-314 only blocks pool/session overlap, it does not restrict reads to non-secret inputs. README.md:2028-2030 documents this gap verbatim — "The read-profile container still mounts the full checkout and any configured extra read directories; do not place credentials or other secrets in those paths. There is no per-file read allowlist yet." The prior autofix author explicitly deferred this as `TASK_GAP_DEFERRED` (issue #6236 comment 5987130753 / 5987362271) without opening a follow-up issue or labeling it `ai:scope-blocked`, so it is still an unmet requirement of the recommendation. The cited Recommendation has three clauses (pool tokens outside; host-side relay auth; restrict reads to non-secret audit inputs); the first two are implemented, the third is not.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/ai_engine.sh: session_mount_root/pool_mount_root realpath chain with single fallback label | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The chained `||` clause reports `isolation_session_dir_unavailable` if either realpath fails, but the pool_dir realpath failure would produce the same label despite the session directory being valid.
  WHY: Diagnostic logs would misidentify which path resolution failed; pool_dir is already validated by realpath in `_ai_engine_isolation_preflight` at line ~207, so this branch is unlikely to fire unless the pool directory is deleted between the preflight and this check.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "restrict model reads to non-secret audit inputs" (from issue #6236 recommendation: "Keep pool tokens outside the model process's filesystem and user identity; supply model authentication through a host-side relay and restrict model reads to non-secret audit inputs.")
  Expected change site: scripts/ai_engine.sh::_ai_engine_claude_run_isolated, container mount construction (the workdir bind mount and AI_ENGINE_ISOLATION_PATHS loop)
  Evidence of absence: The read-profile container mounts the full checkout read-only (`--mount "type=bind,src=${workdir},dst=${workdir},readonly`) and every configured extra read path without a per-file or per-role allowlist. README.md lines 2028-2030 explicitly acknowledge: "The read-profile container still mounts the full checkout and any configured extra read directories; do not place credentials or other secrets in those paths. There is no per-file read allowlist yet." The LAST RUN DIFF adds a session-mount overlap guard but does not restrict the broader read scope. Prior editor comments (entries 5-6 in PR discussion) explicitly deferred this as TASK_GAP_DEFERRED, citing that implementing a per-role inventory requires design work to preserve Git-history access and cross-file reads that read roles need. The specific pool-token exploit IS fixed, but the third clause of the recommendation remains unimplemented.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
- scripts/ai_engine.sh: In `_ai_engine_claude_run_isolated`, the session_id block: `session_mount_root="$(realpath -e -- "${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/claude-read-sessions")" && pool_mount_root="$(realpath -e -- "${pool_dir}")" || { ai_engine_fallback "${role}" isolation_session_dir_unavailable; return 75; }` | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The single `||` clause chains `realpath` on both the session directory and the pool directory. If `realpath -e` on `${pool_dir}` fails, the fallback reason is `isolation_session_dir_unavailable`, misattributing the failure to the session directory rather than the pool directory.
  WHY: A pool directory that becomes invalid between `_ai_engine_isolation_preflight` (which validates it) and this block (TOCTOU: pool dir deleted or unmounted) would be reported as a session-directory failure, misleading operator diagnostics.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "restrict model reads to non-secret audit inputs" (from linked issue #6236 Recommendation: "Keep pool tokens outside the model process's filesystem and user identity; supply model authentication through a host-side relay and restrict model reads to non-secret audit inputs.")
  Expected change site: scripts/ai_engine.sh::_ai_engine_claude_run_isolated, the mount construction block that builds `mounts=(--mount "type=bind,src=${workdir},dst=${workdir},readonly")` and the loop mounting each `AI_ENGINE_ISOLATION_PATHS` entry.
  Evidence of absence: The read-profile container mounts the full checkout read-only and every configured extra read directory with no per-file or per-role allowlist. README.md (lines added in this PR) explicitly states: "The read-profile container still mounts the full checkout and any configured extra read directories; do not place credentials or other secrets in those paths. There is no per-file read allowlist yet." The last run diff's session-overlap guard does not restrict these reads. The pool-token exploit from the issue IS fixed (placeholder token + host relay), but the third clause of the recommendation — restricting model reads — remains unimplemented. The editor's prior summaries explicitly deferred this as `TASK_GAP_DEFERRED` citing design complexity around per-role inventories and Git-history access, but the linked issue itself does not defer this requirement to a follow-up.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
